（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

February 22nd 1928

Sir,
Six 7 cm. guns and 16 boxes of ammunition were yesterday at the Arsenal put on board the gunboat Lung Chi 通濟 which left for the north in the afternoon.
A code telegram was received by General Yang from Chiangchun Feng Kuo Chang instructing him to be ready to dispatch 2,000 troops to Szochun. General Lu, Deputy Military Governor of Shanghai, came from Woosung in the afternoon and had a consultation with General Yang about the matter. It now appears that General Yang and the troops under his direct command are controlled by Chiangchun Feng of Nanking while General Lu and the troops under his command are under the direct control of the Central Government.
Boats containing two thousand piculs of rice arrived in Woosung yesterday from Wuhu. This rice is a present from the Central Government to General Lu's troops.
It is reported that the rebels in Shanghai have organised an assassination corps, the headquarters of which are in the western part of Frenchtown. It is said that twelve men, amongst whom are Tsu Hsi Zung 朱錫貞 and Woo Ching Jou 吳敬舟 who formerly belonged to General Chen Chi Kai's bodyguard, have offered their services for work in the new Corps.
The following is an extract from the Deutsche Zeitung fur China, dated Feby 21st.
"MISSING.
"Missing since Thursday the 17th instant, the German subject Richard Wendt (Merchant) late of the German Southsea Phosphat Company. He is thirty years of age, born at Cuxhaven, slim build, height 1.70 meter, fair, clean shaven, pale complexion and grey eyes. He left the Savoy Hotel in the evening about 8 o'clock probably wearing a overcoat. As suicide is out of the question foul play or accident is suspected.
Any information please refer to the German Consulate".

Your Obedient Servant,
[Signature]
Chief Detective Inspector.

（左侧批注：）
D/S

情报官登记簿
第 50 号
日期 28 / 2 / 29
上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处。
（侦探股）

1928 年 2 月 22 日

先生：
昨日，六门 7 厘米口径火炮及 16 箱弹药在兵工厂被装上“通济”号炮舰，该舰于下午启程北上。
杨将军收到来自长春冯国璋的一封密电，指示他准备派遣 2,000 名士兵前往苏州。上海副军事督军卢将军下午从吴淞赶来，就此事与杨将军进行了磋商。目前看来，杨将军及其直接指挥的部队受南京的冯国璋控制，而卢将军及其指挥的部队则直接受中央政府控制。
载有两千担大米的船只昨日从芜湖抵达吴淞。这批大米是中央政府对卢将军部队的馈赠。
据报，上海的叛乱分子已组织了一支暗杀队，其总部设在法租界西部。据说有十二人主动请缨加入该新成立的队伍，其中包括曾隶属于陈其凯将军卫队的朱錫貞和吳敬舟。
以下是 2 月 21 日《德文中国报》（Deutsche Zeitung fur China）的摘录。
“失踪。
德国籍人士理查德·温特（Richard Wendt，商人），前德国南海磷酸盐公司职员，自本月 17 日星期四起失踪。他现年三十岁，生于库克斯港（Cuxhaven），身材瘦削，身高 1.70 米，金发，面部光洁无须，面色苍白，灰眼睛。他于晚间约 8 点离开萨伏伊酒店，当时可能身穿大衣。鉴于自杀可能性不大，怀疑涉及他杀或意外事故。
如有任何线索，请联系德国领事馆”。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
总探长。

（左侧批注：）
D/S
